title: Water supply riser.
officialText:
Water supply risers from the shower valve to the shower head outlet, whether exposed or concealed, shall
be attached to the structure. The attachment to the structure shall be made by the use of support devices designed for use with the
specific piping material or by fittings anchored with screws.
